admission_apply.text: You count to twelve. The last stitch is not there. The hem remains ordinary cloth.

native.admission_inspect: Undyed hem, palm-wide. Twelve stitches along the edge. Counted again: eleven.
apply_texts: You choose one end and call it first. The far end keeps a count of its own.
You count to twelve. The last stitch is not there. The hem remains ordinary cloth.
You press the doubled thread flat. It stays. The two totals do not become one.
You stop at eleven and refuse the recount. For a moment the edge agrees.
You stop at eleven. A blink later the twelfth stitch is back, or the first is gone.
inspect_texts: A loose fiber lifts with your breath and lies down elsewhere. You did not choose the place.
Starting from the other end changes nothing. The hem offers two totals and keeps both.
The edge looks handled thin. Whatever number you settle on, the next glance revises it.
The fault is a doubled thread, not a missing stitch. Naming it does not fix the sum.
The hem lies flat, yet the count will not. Twelve, then eleven, under a steady eye.
Undyed hem, palm-wide. Twelve stitches along the edge. Counted again: eleven.
native.name: Twice-Counted Hem
